questions.model: I do: tch says /ch/: k-i-tch-e-n, kitchen. wr says /r/: r-i-s-t, wrist.

questions.q: read and write: catch, write, picture
questions.model: I do first: catch: c-a-tch. After a short vowel /ch/ is often tch, so I write c, a, t, c, h.

questions.q: write a sentence with friend and because
questions.a: For example: My friend laughed because the puppy was funny.
